title: Particles floating off ice spheres. Discolored with 1 time in dishwasher.
text: Particles floating off ice spheres. Discolored with 1 time in dishwasher.. I hand washed as suggested before first use.  It makes sphere-ish shaped ice.  Reason for 1 star is every sphere releases particles into drink.  Keep in mind I boil bottled water (for clear ice) and let cool,  then pour into molds and freeze. I have no idea what these particles are but it's happening with every sphere.  Also after 3 batches of spheres I decided to clean in the dishwasher. Now they are discolored.  Looks as if there's still soap on them but there isn't.  I then hand washed multiple times and the discoloration won't come off.
